02 / YOUR ESTIMATE

Estimate = quantity × entered price − transport − other costs. Actual bids, quality, fees and availability may differ. Confirm before travelling.

03 / THINKING ABOUT WAITING?

Explore a sell-later scenario.

You choose the future price. This is arithmetic, not a forecast or advice to store your crop.

Your what-if comparison

Later amount = remaining quantity × your assumed later price − waiting costs. Break-even ignores selling costs that differ between the two dates. Prices, spoilage and storage risks are uncertain; this does not predict the future.

04 / BEFORE YOU GO

Good decisions start with trustworthy information.

Check the crop variety, date, unit and market reporting the price. A reported modal price is not a guaranteed offer for your produce.
